elements.requirement: Section 28 of the Crime (Sentences) Act 1997 applies to a life prisoner in respect of whom a minimum term order has been made.
elements.quote: This section applies to a life prisoner in respect of whom a minimum term order has been made

elements.requirement: Any reference in section 28 of the Crime (Sentences) Act 1997 to the relevant part of a life prisoner's sentence is a reference to the part of the sentence specified in the minimum term order.
elements.quote: any reference in this section to the relevant part of such a prisoner’s sentence is a reference to the part of the sentence specified in the order

elements.requirement: In section 28(1B)(a) of the Crime (Sentences) Act 1997, the section does not apply to a prisoner unless a minimum term order has been made in respect of each of those sentences.
elements.quote: this section does not apply to him

elements.requirement: For the purposes of section 28 of the Crime (Sentences) Act 1997, a "minimum term order" includes an order under subsection (2) of section 82A of the Powers of Criminal Courts (Sentencing) Act 2000 regarding the determination of a minimum term for a life sentence not fixed by law.
elements.quote: subsection (2) of section 82A of the Powers of Criminal Courts (Sentencing) Act 2000 (determination of minimum term in respect of life sentence that is not fixed by law)

elements.requirement: For the purposes of section 28 of the Crime (Sentences) Act 1997, a "minimum term order" includes an order under subsection (2) of section 269 of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 regarding the determination of a minimum term for a mandatory life sentence.
elements.quote: subsection (2) of section 269 of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 (determination of minimum term in respect of mandatory life sentence)
